name: hello
_note: The factory's 'hello world': the smallest protocol that proves the whole control plane end to end, with no LLM. One dispatched CODE node checks the repo out (checkout: true), takes a light but genuine reading of it (a file count + a sample via git ls-files), and posts a friendly greeting to the merge request through the forge API (forge-agnostic, via the gh2gl proxy — the node holds no forge token). A single self-contained check settles that it read the tree AND that the greeting landed. Trigger `/hello` on an MR comment; watch it on the dashboard: webhook -> conductor -> disposable microVM -> checkout -> forge API -> check -> status.
